recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Future copyediting can clean minor grammar in the ingredient definition under a separate editorial tracker, but FHIR-31785 does not require a source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-31785 asked whether AdministrableProductDefinition.producedFrom and .ingredient were redundant. The Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept both elements and requested clarifying text that contrasts the concepts and avoids duplicative use.
initial_application: No exact FHIR-31785-tagged source commit was found. The relevant clarification appears in 2021 AdministrableProductDefinition commits that added the producedFrom not-raw-ingredients contrast and the ingredient only-needed wording; Jira then recorded changes as applied on 2022-02-02.
additional_context: AdministrableProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Related final BRR decisions FHIR-31778, FHIR-31779, FHIR-31808, and FHIR-41432 refined the same source area, including the current producedFrom/formOf wording, Ingredient reference direction, and one-to-one producedFrom clarification. A 2020 BRR Zulip thread supports the conceptual distinction, and no conflicting Confluence or issue-key Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already states that producedFrom identifies specific manufactured items used to prepare the administrable form, while ingredient is only needed when ingredients are not specified through ManufacturedItemDefinition/produdedFrom or incoming Ingredient references.

related_jiras.note: Refined producedFrom/formOf wording in the same AdministrableProductDefinition area and explains why the current producedFrom text differs from the older FHIR-31785 comment text.

Changed Ingredient references so AdministrableProductDefinition.ingredient became a coded shortcut while detailed Ingredient resources refer back to the product.
Added the current clarification that producedFrom may be used even for one-to-one manufactured-to-administrable cases.
